internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service High Error Rate Resolved
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 11:20 UTC, an alert was triggered due to a high error rate in the cart service, reaching 50%. Initial diagnosis confirmed error injection as the root cause. The issue was addressed by disabling the cartFailure flag at 11:39 UTC after approval from the second on-call evaluator. Recovery was verified with error rates returning to normal levels shortly after the intervention.

Other services such as checkout and frontend also showed elevated error rates but were not the primary cause. The incident was resolved without further escalation.

Timeline:
- 11:20:03: Alert received for cart service error rate spike.
- 11:39:44: Diagnosis confirmed error injection in cart service.
- 11:39:50: Flag disabling proposed, approved, and executed.
- 11:39:50: Recovery verified with normalized error rates.

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: Intermittent Cart Service Errors Resolved
external.body: Between 11:20 and 11:40 UTC on November 8, some customers experienced errors when using the cart service. Our team identified the issue as an internal error injection affecting the cart functionality. The problem was quickly addressed and service returned to normal shortly after 11:40 UTC. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.

output.summary: A high error rate in the cart service was detected and resolved by disabling a faulty feature flag, restoring normal service operation.
output.impact: Customers experienced errors when using the cart service, potentially affecting their ability to add items to their carts during the incident window.
output.root_cause: Error injection in the cart service caused by a faulty feature flag (cartFailure) led to a 50% error rate spike.
output.resolution: The cartFailure feature flag was disabled following approval, which immediately reduced the error rate to normal levels and restored service functionality.

lessons.lesson: Implement stricter controls and automated rollback mechanisms for feature flags to prevent prolonged error injection incidents.
lessons.applies_when: When a feature flag causes a significant increase in error rates in the cart service.

lessons.lesson: Ensure rapid multi-approver workflows are in place for critical flag changes to minimize incident duration.
lessons.applies_when: When high error rates require urgent flag disabling actions.

action_items: Review and enhance feature flag management policies.
Implement automated monitoring for feature flag impacts on error rates.
Train on-call teams on rapid multi-approver incident response procedures.
